paper_title: A longitudinal cohort study uncovers plasma protein biomarkers predating clinical onset and treatment response of rheumatoid arthritis
prediction_task: Binary prediction of RA treatment response (responder vs non-responder) to MTX+LEF or MTX+HCQ from plasma proteome

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Small sample sizes (MTX+HCQ n=59) limit robustness of ML models; larger cohorts needed to ensure reliability of treatment-response predictions.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Acknowledged as limitation; used 100-round resampling, added independent ELISA validation cohort (n=65) with consistent biomarker findings.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Study should compare LASSO against alternative ML methods (XGBoost, Random Forest) to ensure chosen approach is not arbitrarily selected.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added RF and XGBoost comparisons; LASSO yielded higher median ROC (0.88 vs 0.79/0.73), likely due to small sample size favoring simpler models.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Class imbalance between responders and non-responders not explicitly addressed; needs documentation of imbalance handling strategy.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Ensured equal numbers of responders/non-responders per random sampling; improved median training ROC from 0.87 to 0.92 for MTX+HCQ.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Stability of LASSO-selected biomarkers across alternative feature selection methods not demonstrated; need to show same biomarkers selected by multiple approaches.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Evaluated biomarker rankings across 5 feature selection methods (ElasticNet, XGBoost, RF, RFE-SVM, stability selection); ECI2 and key biomarkers consistently top-10.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Model interpretability via post-hoc explainability tools (e.g., SHAP) not provided; feature importance plots needed to identify most predictive proteins.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added SHAP analysis for both MTX+LEF and MTX+HCQ models; SHAP feature-effect directions consistent with LASSO-identified biomarkers.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: No independent validation cohort for treatment-response biomarker panel; need ELISA/MRM-based validation in additional patients to confirm reliability.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Recruited independent cohort (46 MTX+HCQ, 19 MTX+LEF); ELISA validation confirmed biomarker panel with ROC 0.90 (LEF) and 0.86 (HCQ).
